# Vendored ZIP support

`fflate-0.8.3.js` is the unmodified UMD browser distribution of [fflate 0.8.3](https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate), downloaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.3/umd/index.js`.

Its MIT license is included in `fflate-LICENSE.txt`. It is bundled locally so ZIP import also works offline and when opening `index.html` directly.
